verdict.rationale: Capacities is a note-taking SaaS, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. First-party docs describe a Model Context Protocol page for connecting your own agent or bot by implementing an MCP client against a Capacities space. Chat Connectors also link ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Le Chat to a space, and a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tools and resources and the MCP auth and setup flow, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
